description: FREE, no account needed. Size a search_areas run before starting it: how many grid points, and, when the user's account is connected, how many areas it already covers for the query (those are skipped). It cannot give an exact cost, because billing is 1 token per NEW business found (one new lead costs one token) and nobody knows how many exist before looking.

areas.description: Area names like "Houston, Texas", or ids from find_areas

country.description: Country name, as listed by find_areas

mode.description: grid covers the whole area (default here); city pages from the centre and is cheaper for small towns

name: estimate_area_search
title: Size an area search
